decisions.reason: The flame-retardant jacquard draws directly on the firm's functional contract-fabric knowledge, and its own website page shows the firm can read project feedback and keep improving it.
The double-face wool-blend extends established weaving know-how, but its low visibility and blend composition clash with the move away from hard-to-recycle blends, so its risk is moderate.

The wool bouclé leno combines the firm's sheer-fabric and wool expertise in line with the renewable-materials strategy, though its modest website presence after two years leaves some risk of a collection cleanup.

The newly launched braided-structure fabric builds on existing upholstery and curtain capabilities and has its own page, so the firm should give it time to learn from early market results before judging it.
